question: Under what condition does the vision of the Kula tradition arise in a practitioner?
premises: Kula-vision may arise in a person.
Its arising can depend on fortune.
The condition is presented as a possibility.
inference: The vision of the Kula tradition arises, if at all, through the force of good fortune.
plain_english: If, by the force of good fortune, O Goddess, the vision of the Kula arises.
